ranking: Equal-percentile mean of MACD repair strength, structural integrity (distance to prior high), and liquidity; tie-break by ADV20 then symbol.
market_risk: Equal-weight eligible-stock close-to-close return; rolling 20-session sample stdev annualized by sqrt(252).
execution: T-close signal -> T+1 regular-session open -> original T+5 regular-session close; no fixed stop/take-profit; 10 bps round-trip research cost.
cash_layer: Canonical alpha uses 0% cash yield. 3M Treasury overlay is tracked separately.
